Name: Anime Style Susan with Seasonal Outfits SVE (Haru Recolor)
Author: mountlover
Description:
A recolor for [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DawnWander/mods?gameId=1303]DawnWander[/url]'s Haru Okumura replacer for Susan from Stardew Valley Expanded that more closely matches Susan's original hair color and skin tone. Made with permission by Dawn. Includes seasonal variants for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE

[/url]To install, extract into the Mods folder after already having installed SMAPI, Content Patcher, Stardew Valley Expanded, and (optionally) Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE﻿ to enable seasonal variants.
